text:
maria_sales: Hey @olivia_legal, ACME needs a copy of our SOC 2 Type II asap to progress contracting. They require an NDA before we hand over the full report. Can we fast-track a redacted copy + NDA routing? They want this before the week ends.

olivia_legal: Hi Maria — we can provide a redacted SOC2 summary today if security signs off on the redactions. For the unredacted report we need a signed NDA and legal review of any customer-supplied NDA. How fast can you share the customer legal contact?

maria_sales: Contact is contracts@acme.corp (cc: @jake_se). I'm pinging them now.

jake_se: Adding context — our POC is live and they specifically asked for encryption/KMS and access control sections. If we pre-redact third-party vendor names and internal control IDs, would that satisfy them for interim review?

ryan_security: I can run a redaction pass. Plan is to remove vendor product names, control IDs, and any IP ranges. After redaction we'll upload to the secure data room and legal can route the NDA. ETA ~4 hours if nothing blocks. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

olivia_legal: Sounds good. Maria — please confirm whether ACME will sign our standard mutual NDA or insist on theirs. If it's their template, legal will need to review which could be 24–48h.

maria_sales: They're open to ours but asked if we can accept a short countersigned addendum instead. I'll propose our template first.

docuploader-bot: [system] SOC2-redaction_draft_v1.pdf uploaded to secure-data-room by ryan_security. link: https://redwood.securevault/example (expires in 72h)

ash_eng: Quick technical note — the report references our internal KMS provider name. For external consumption let's replace that with a generic phrase like "customer-managed KMS / industry-standard KMS" so we don't surface infra specifics. I can prepare the wording.

ryan_security: Ash — good call. I'll swap vendor names for generic descriptors and scrub any lines that mention internal endpoints. After that I'll attach the final redacted PDF to a DocuSign envelope (per Olivia).

olivia_legal: Agreed on the flow: 1) Ryan uploads redacted PDF to secure room 2) I create a DocuSign envelope with our NDA and add the redacted PDF as an attachment 3) Once NDA is countersigned, we can share the full file access to ACME from the room and log the disclosure. Ryan, confirm when the final file is ready and I'll create the envelope. :white_check_mark:

maria_sales: ACME is asking if we can do an "interim attestation" — a one-paragraph attestation letter while NDA processes. That might unblock them for procurement. Can legal generate that?

jake_se: That letter should mention scope: SOC2 Type II period and that full report is available upon NDA. Short and formal.

olivia_legal: Yes, we can provide a one-paragraph attestation letter today. I'll draft it and post here for quick sign-off.

ryan_security: Final note — I'll target the redaction + upload in the next 3.5 hours. If anything slips I'll post an interim summary snippet they can accept now.

maria_sales: Thanks everyone — ACME is pushing for EOD PST. Please flag if timing risks. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
